thread:
anya: quick check: how do we want to surface required fields in the new dashboard forms? asterisk only feels cheap and disappears when zoomed
tom: i'm leaning toward an inline 'Required' chip for clarity on desktop, but show only a subtle glyph on mobile to save space
lucy: prefer consistency: small visual indicator + text on hover/focus. accessibility-wise, aria-required must be present. chips might break wrapping for long labels
dev_rel: dev concern: chips add extra DOM nodes per field; if we can toggle span vs visually hidden text that'd be better. also avoid using placeholder for required state
a11y: accessibility notes: 1) use aria-required on the form control 2) if you expose a tooltip with reason, ensure aria-describedby points to it 3) keyboard users must be able to trigger tooltip (focusable button)
anya: decision proposal: always render a minimal glyph (CSS ::after) for density. on focus or hover replace with visible 'Required' text + optional short reason when policy enforces it. tooltip must be keyboard accessible
tom: +1. also let's add a dev token for indicator contrast so QA can validate across themes
anya: second topic: delete pool modal. current text = "Delete pool? This cannot be undone." too terse. typed confirm vs checkbox?
lucy: risk-based: small/non-prod pools -> single destructive CTA + undo toast. large/prod pools -> typed confirm and list of linked resources
dev_rel: implement size/flag check server-side to force confirm level. small pools undo via soft-delete and a 30s undo window might be enough
a11y: typed field must have aria-label and live region for mismatch. prefer autocomplete="off" and ensure focus lands in the field when modal opens
anya: wrap-up: agreed on glyph + focus-reveal text for required; risk-tiered delete confirmations; accessibility checklist: aria-required, aria-describedby for tooltips, focus-first-invalid on submit, undo toast for soft deletes. i'll post mocks and an implementation checklist later today
deploy-bot: FYI: design token "indicator-contrast" will update at 03:00 UTC tomorrow, check contrast before rollout.
